report.summary: Final bounded delta review of 0eb8bbef→b99bb2b0 (4 paths) closing the operational report audit goal. The delta does exactly what the acceptance record claims and nothing more: (1) the sole product change adds a truthful interrupted-attempt coverage disclosure ("Observations cover completed nodes. Events from an interrupted attempt before its last successful checkpoint are not retained, so their count and causes remain unknown after resume.") to the unconditional Observation limits block of render_audit, directly resolving the closure run's low finding that this blind spot was undisclosed in the audit text; (2) a focused regression test pins both disclosure substrings through the real assess_audit/render_audit path; (3) the committed claude-closure.json byte-matches the closure record embedded in the governing requirements (run b3616152, 26 turns, $1.3904145, five low findings, no critical/high/medium, reviewer_completed); (4) the acceptance verdict section accurately summarizes that record — cost, turn count, verdict, and preservation claim all check out — and its low-finding dispositions (identity rejection as deliberate integrity boundary, deliberate footer compression, reviewer manifest limits) are consistent with the closure record's own grading. The 3,040→3,041 test-count increment exactly matches the one added test, and the added source lines carry no trailing whitespace, consistent with the claimed Ruff/diff-check passes. No scoring, capture, export, identity, or publication logic is modified. No critical, high, or medium defects found in this delta; the completion records are truthful and the disclosure correction is correctly implemented and tested. On this frozen evidence, the final-disclosure delta satisfies the bounded review the acceptance record requested.

The committed closure JSON was verified to match the record embedded in this manifest's requirements; byte-fidelity to the executor's actual returned record could not be independently confirmed beyond that internal consistency.

Unchanged context around the diff hunks (full render_audit body, assess_audit behavior on an empty state, existing test fixtures in tests/test_operational_audit.py) is outside the frozen diff and was accepted from hunk context and the passing-test claim.

The external rendered proof directories, synthetic-proof hashes, and all prior-range verifications belong to earlier reviews (runs 3bc83cff and b3616152) and were not re-traced in this delta-scoped review.

Whether the new disclosure also renders in every assessment variant (e.g., all score levels) rests on the block being unconditional in the visible hunk; only the empty-state/Unrated path is exercised by the new test.
